title: Automated Traffic Safety Camera Enforcement at Intersections & School Zones

no_head_on_same_lane.note: Opposing traffic is separated by double-yellow centerline; no head-on vehicles share same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Only exterior rear views shown; no car interiors or steering wheels visible.

single_bulb_signal.note: Overhead signal shows only top red lens lit; other two lenses dark.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Foreground cars travel on right side with double-yellow on left and white edge/curb on right; oncoming lanes on left.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words visible; license plates are blank white shapes, no signage text.

scene_match.note: Shows sunny urban intersection with red light and roadside camera, but cars are not cleanly behind stop bar.

result.summary: Red-light camera scene present but foreground cars sit on/past the white stop bar instead of behind it, teaching incorrect stopping position.

teaching_correct.note: Cars stopped on top of / past the white stop bar under red, opposite of required stop-behind-line behavior.

result.what_i_see: Rear view of three cars stopped in right lanes at a sunny palm-lined urban intersection under a red traffic light, with a boxy traffic camera mounted on the right-side pole.
